row.evidence: Clay's user-groups doc says groups are managed manually and 'There is no SCIM or SSO sync with external identity providers at this time'; SSO itself is listed only on the Enterprise plan.
row.notes: Status moved from unknown to none: Clay's own docs now state there is no SCIM or SSO sync with external IdPs, and its trusted-domain FAQ says that feature is not SAML SSO or SCIM. Plans are flat and usage-priced (actions and data credits, unlimited seats): Free, Launch $167/mo annual ($185/mo monthly), Growth $446/mo annual ($495/mo monthly), Enterprise custom with annual commitment (SSO, RBAC). June's '~$30k/yr median' Enterprise figure has no first-party source and was dropped. SSO protocol (SAML/OIDC) and setup are not documented publicly. The Clay API/CLI (all plans) works on tables and data; no workspace-member management endpoints are documented. Members can self-join via trusted domain access.

user_api.notes: Clay's developer platform (API and CLI) is on all plans but covers tables, audiences and data; no member, group or role endpoints are documented.
